text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is about to start. Meanwhile, Gold Ship is contemplating the race in terms of life itself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Conquer a mountain, and you'll be led back to the ocean! No one can stop Gold Ship once she starts rowing. The same is true for races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship must now race against her longtime rivals. The curtains rise on the ultimate race of the Twinkle Series!
